signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLA_GBRPVGRW( N, KL, KU, NCOLS, AB,

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: ncols
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $\mathrm{NCOLS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in band storage, in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(KU+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{KU}) \le i \le \min (N,j+\mathrm{kl})$

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: AFB
params.reference: Details of the LU factorization of the band matrix A, as computed by DGBTRF. U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: ldafb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AFB`. $\mathrm{LDAFB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.
